summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Robot Consulting Co., Ltd., a Japanese foreign private issuer, reporting the results of its annual general meeting of shareholders held on June 26, 2026. The meeting approved routine matters including financial statements, election of a statutory auditor, reduction of stated capital and capital reserve with disposition of surplus, and a partial amendment to the articles of incorporation. The company reported 89.7% representation and all proposals passed. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, tender offer, or restructuring is described.
